demos.title: Midnight Drive
demos.preset_base: YB4 Rubber Bass — six-voice showcase variation
demos.description: A twelve-bar bass groove with six-voice unison, syncopated pluck figures, octave answers and a gradually opening resonant filter.

demos.title: Signal Fire
demos.preset_base: A53 Lead III — singing mono showcase variation
demos.description: An eight-bar singing melody, with two answering phrases, gentle centered vibrato and brief glides into sustained notes.

demos.title: Silver Canopy
demos.description: Five voice-led inner parts support a singing upper voice; factory PWM strings resolve an A7 suspension into D6/9.

demos.title: City Lights
demos.preset_base: A11 Brass Set 1, 8-foot range and short release
demos.description: Syncopated four-note brass hits answer a rising melody, then a Cm9-F9 turnaround lands on a six-voice B-flat sixth.

demos.title: Slow Horizon
demos.preset_base: YP2 Slow Horizon, lighter sub oscillator
demos.description: Six spacious voices hold common tones through major and minor ninth chords; slow PWM and a gentle filter opening lead to a G9 suspension resolving into C6/9.
